generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A structured artifact is validated locally, then crosses a text or connector boundary that rewrites bytes while the delivery continues to trust the pre-transfer manifest.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Create or transmit encoded shards through a lossy character conversion and certify the local digest without proving the bytes stored by the destination.
generalized_learning.reusable_control: For every encoded shard, require strict local round-trip plus local-versus-remote Git blob identity before constructing the published tree.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Pack encoded artifacts with one deterministic implementation and keep shard bytes in an ASCII-safe representation across connector calls.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Fail publication when any encoded part is non-ASCII, fails strict Base64 decoding, fails manifest round-trip, or produces a different remote blob identity.

skill_changes.change: Canonical deterministic sharding plus ASCII-only strict Base64 validation is mandatory before certificate construction.
Connector publication blocks unless every create-blob SHA equals the locally computed Git blob SHA and logical round-trip remains valid.
